item.title: Mixture of Experts: Are They Really Experts?
item.description: Mixture of Experts is everywhere in modern LLMs, but nobody seems to check whether the 'experts' are actually experts at anything. This project take pretrained Switch Transformer, decomposes its expert activations with sparse autoencoders, and asks what the routing and the features actually say about specialization.
